name_zh: 缅甸·吴努：佛教社会主义与民主政变僧侣
name_en: Myanmar U Nu: Buddhist Socialism & Democracy Coup Monks
description_zh: 吴努 (1907-1995) 缅甸首任总理 (1948-1958, 1960-1962)，推行佛教社会主义福利政策，1958年主动移权给内阁看守，1960年大选回归，1962年奈温政变下台，晚年流亡发动8888起义支持。
description_en: U Nu (1907-1995) Myanmar first PM (1948-1958, 1960-1962), implemented Buddhist socialism welfare policy, 1958 voluntarily handed power to caretaker cabinet, 1960 election returned, 1962 Ne Win coup ousted, late exile supported 8888 uprising.
reason_zh: 吴努代表佛教伦理与社会主义经济的独特融合尝试，展示了民主领袖如何在军人政治阴影下通过道德权威治国，其主动移权罕见展现民主成熟度，却终究无法阻挡军事政变。
reason_en: U Nu represents unique fusion of Buddhist ethics and socialist economics, demonstrating how democratic leader governs through moral authority under military politics shadow, his voluntary handover rare showing democratic maturity yet ultimately unable to stop military coup.
steps_zh: 研究吴努早年学生领袖与反英斗争
分析1948-1958首相期佛教社会主义立法
探讨1958年主动移权看守内阁罕见民主操作
评估1962年奈温政变与吴努流亡晚年
总结佛教社会主义民主政变僧侣模式对缅甸政治文化的深远烙印
steps_en: Study U Nu early student leader and anti-British struggle
Explore 1958 voluntary handover to caretaker cabinet rare democratic operation
Evaluate 1962 Ne Win coup and U Nu exile late years
Summarize Buddhist socialism democracy coup monks model profound imprint on Myanmar political culture
expected_zh: 理解佛教伦理如何为社会主义提供道德正当性，掌握民主领袖道德权威与军事强权的不对称博弈，评估吴努模式对后世缅甸民主运动的启示与局限。
expected_en: Understand how Buddhist ethics legitimize socialism morally, grasp democratic leader moral authority and military power asymmetric game, evaluate U Nu model implications for later Myanmar democracy movements.
case_zh: 1948 总理；1958 移权；1960 回归；1962 政变下台；1988 支持起义。佛教社会主义民主政变僧侣范式永存。
case_en: 1948 PM; 1958 handover; 1960 return; 1962 coup ousted; 1988 supported uprising. Buddhist socialism democracy coup monks paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Buddhist socialism; voluntary power transfer; military coup; monk politics
